name: Perspective-Correct 3D Gaussian Splatting via Plücker Coordinates
definition: A method to compute the value of a 3D Gaussian for a given viewing ray in screen space without matrix inversion, using Plücker coordinates to represent the ray and calculate the distance to the Gaussian's center.
summary: Perspective-Correct 3D Gaussian Splatting via Plücker Coordinates is a numerically stable rasterization method that computes perspective-correct splat evaluation without matrix inversion, handling degenerate ellipsoids efficiently.
